_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-21 00:36:58Z)**_

Yes, caveman is on, in `caveman` mode. This session received the hook output (`CAVEMAN MODE ACTIVE — mode: caveman`), and the per-prompt reminder also fired on your message.

You don't see the logline because it isn't meant for you. `caveman-activate.js` sends its SessionStart output as hidden context, so only Claude sees it. The plugin README says: "SessionStart stdout is injected as hidden system context — Claude sees it, users don't."

The visible indicator is a statusline badge. You don't have it: you use your own `~/.claude/statusline-command.sh`, which has no caveman snippet, so the plugin didn't touch it. To see the mode in your status bar, add the snippet under "Custom statusline" in `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/caveman/src/hooks/README.md` to that script.
